_comment: D2K Controls pad (docs/controls.md). Values are SDL game controller inputs: B<n> a button (A 0, B 1, Back 4, Start 6, LeftShoulder 9, RightShoulder 10, D-pad up/down/left/right 11/12/13/14), A<n>+/- an axis direction (left stick X 0, Y 1; right stick X 2, Y 3; left trigger 4); a list binds several inputs. The D-pad drives the stick, alongside the left Circle Pad: Ocarina's menus and movement use the stick, not the N64 D-pad. C-buttons sit on the right stick for the second Circle Pad.
